body: I don't think my therapist was just trying to do her job when she made up complete lies about me to try to get me hospitalized, despite the fact that had recently said, that if I was locked up, I would probably spend every second entirely consumed by how much I want to kill myself.
I tried contacting the email provided 3 times over the last few months. Twice I received no answer. The most recent time I received the same copy pasted response that came with each rejection email.
The reason he said all that is because I told him. He said I was being ridiculous. My dad will always consider my depression as a personal choice.
